description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Regulations on Transfer Pricing under Inland Revenue Act
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made under Section 194 of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, specifically addressing transfer pricing rules for international transactions between associated enterprises. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for tax compliance, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it includes a ministerial signature (Mangala Samaraweera), this is merely the promulgating authority and does not constitute a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio description that would make it a government-related type.
